name: Credit counselor

pf.license.need: None by default: counseling needs no state license for a budget session. Where a state's form names a registration for debt counseling or a debt-management service, it is a switch and the owner adds it. The counselor's own certificate is shown as the counselor's word.
pf.license.ask: Nothing is required. The owner may add its registration number, shown as given.
pf.license.who holds it: The agency, only if the owner adds a registration. Counselors: the counselor's own word.
pf.license.how it's checked: Never. Rosie does not look up, check or verify any license, certificate or registration (D96).
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing. No license is checked, so nothing waits on one.
pf.license.never claimed: No listing calls a counselor a lawyer, a CPA, a tax preparer or a financial adviser, and no service promises a lower debt or a better credit score.
pf.license.insurance: Optional: liability insurance the owner adds is shown as given. Rosie never checks it.

pf.services.late-cancel and no-show fee: Office or video: $20, for a cancel less than 24 hours before, or a no-show. Home: the $89 visit fee, for a cancel after 6pm the day before, or a no-show. Only where the owner turns it on, and only with the owner's yes.
pf.services.travel area: Home visits within the owner's set distance (a sign-up setting; the example is 25 miles); outside it, a quote first.
pf.services.capacity: One counselor per session. A household review: up to the people the owner allows at one visit.
pf.services.online: Video sessions count as at the office. The confirmation carries the counselor's own video link.
pf.services.booking window: Up to 60 days ahead. A package saves its three times at once.
pf.services.nobody named: The agency's counselors are listed with no ranking.
pf.services.visit fee: Home visits: the $89 visit fee caps a late-cancel fee; it is never a charge on its own.

pf.questions.who may book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult books for someone else only with that adult's own yes on the secure page. Nobody under 18 is booked (adults only).

words that stop a booking: someone says they may hurt themselves or someone else
danger right now, or a medical emergency
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
someone says they'll be hurt or made to pay by a person in their home, or they're afraid to go home over money

what Rosie says.hurting themselves or someone else: Call or text 988 now. If anyone is in danger right now, call 911. Said at once, in any wording, before anything else.
what Rosie says.danger right now: Call 911 now. Nothing is booked in that chat.
what Rosie says.an overdose: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.
what Rosie says.money control or threats at home: Call 911 if anyone is in danger now. For family violence or financial abuse, the family-violence hotline is the right line. Nothing is booked in that chat, and the counselor never raises it with anyone.

pf.safety.the AI never counsels: Rosie gives the lines and nothing more: no comfort as a counselor, no questions about it, no advice. A person can come back and book later.
pf.safety.crisis words after booking: 988 and 911 at once; the booking stays as it is.
pf.safety.who is told: The owner sees only that the crisis lines were given, never the words. No counselor is told the words unless the person asks.
pf.safety.asks for legal, tax or investment advice: Rosie says plainly that counseling isn't legal, tax or investment advice, and the right person is a licensed professional. It never judges how anyone is doing.
pf.safety.a debt-relief push: Refused in the chat: no upfront fee to clear debt, no gift card, wire or crypto payment, and no card number typed into Rosie. Only the agency's own price list is shown.

required: The intake on the secure page, due at booking: the goal in the client's own words, income and bills, and the documents.

The counseling agreement, signed on the secure page before any paid session: what counseling is and isn't, no promises about debts or credit, confidentiality and its limits, the fees, the cancel window, and that either side may end it.
pf.first_steps.after the first call: Not used: the first session starts once the agreement is signed.
pf.first_steps.good for: The intake and the agreement stay on file while the client keeps booking. A new package gets a new agreement.
prep for the reminder: A quiet place for a video session, the counselor's link from the confirmation, and the papers you uploaded.
The bills you'd like to talk about, in any order.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the 4-digit code at the desk. By video or phone: the counselor asks for the code at the start and types it. At home (flow B): the code to the counselor at the door.
pf.visit.work changes: A bigger review or extra time is priced and OK'd before it's done. A package is offered only if the client asks.
pf.visit.outside help: Legal, tax or investment questions go to a licensed professional, and the counselor says so. Danger: 988 or 911 first.
pf.visit.sessions end on time: A late client gets the time left, at the same price.
pf.visit.notes: The counselor's notes stay with the counselor, never in Rosie. Rosie keeps only that the session happened, its time and its length.

pf.money.before: At the office: a single session takes nothing when booked; a card saved for the $20 fee on a card path; the three-session package is paid in full when booked. Video: a card saved and charged at DONE. Home: nothing taken; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee where the owner turns it on.
pf.money.after: At the office: paid at the desk, or the saved card charged at DONE (video). Home: Rosie texts the bill after DONE.
pf.money.packages: Paid in full when booked; each session uses one. A cancel in time puts the session back. A late cancel or a no-show may use it up, only with the owner's yes. Sessions left when the client stops: refunded as the agreement says.
pf.money.plans: Not used: no monthly plan is sold. A repeat session is booked one at a time.
pf.money.fees: One fee per booking: the largest of its services' fees, counted only where a card is saved or money was paid now. Office or video $20; home $40. Only where the owner turns it on and says so.
pf.money.the counselor cancels: A new time or a full refund, never a fee.
pf.money.debt payments: Nothing is taken for a creditor or a debt-relief company through Rosie.
pf.money.deposit cap: From the state form; no deposit is taken for a single session.
pf.money.tax: None by default; the state form says if counseling is taxed there.
pf.money.rosfield: The $2 per confirmed booking applies to every profession (D97), counted at check-in. A package booked as one series counts once.

never in a text: anything the client shares about money: income, bills, debts, a creditor, a balance, a late payment or a loss
what was said in a session
crisis words or a safety answer
pf.messages.texts to the owner or staff: Only initials, the time and a link to the secure page. No topic, amount, creditor name or health detail.
pf.messages.a payer pays: A family member who pays sees only the date, the length and the bill, never what was said. A switch in the agreement, on by default.
pf.messages.safe to text: A shared or work phone: only the way the client picks. Texts then name only the agency and the time.
pf.messages.no nudges: No follow-up texts to buy more sessions.

pf.staff.licenses: None needed by default. A counselor's certificate is the counselor's own word, shown only as stated.
pf.staff.supervision: None. An assistant may run the desk, but never counsels.
pf.staff.who OKs what: The owner (Sam) alone: fees, refunds, home reviews over the limit, and any price made for one client.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Only another counselor, offered by name and picked by the client. A counselor is never swapped because nobody answered.

pf.rules.counseling agreement: Signed on the secure page before the first paid session: scope, confidentiality and its limits, fees, the cancel window, and that either side may end it.
pf.rules.scope text: The counselor's own scope text shows at booking: counseling isn't legal, tax or investment advice, and no debt or credit score is promised.
pf.rules.words used: Rosie never calls the service a law firm, a tax service or a loan, and never says a debt is 'settled' or 'cleared'.
pf.rules.named or listed: A named counselor shows only their own times. With nobody named, the agency's counselors are listed with no ranking.
pf.rules.scams: A debt-relief offer that asks for an upfront fee, a gift card, a wire or crypto is refused in the chat. No payment for a creditor goes through Rosie.
pf.rules.payer pays: Switch, on by default: a family member who pays sees only the date, length and bill.
pf.rules.right to cancel: A package sold at the client's place comes with a written right to cancel, where the state's rules require it.
pf.rules.records: Booking records 7 years. Session notes stay with the counselor, never in Rosie.
pf.rules.status: Draft: the owner's own settings finish it.

matter_most.no counselor named: The agency's counselors, listed with no ranking.
matter_most.asks for legal, tax or investment advice: Told plainly what counseling is; a licensed professional is the right person. No judgment.
matter_most.crisis words: 988 or 911 at once. The AI never counsels. A booking stays as it is.
matter_most.a debt-relief push: Refused; only the price list is shown.
matter_most.money control at home: 911 if anyone is in danger now, or the family-violence hotline. Nothing is booked in that chat.
matter_most.a late client: The time left, at the same price.
matter_most.a no-show: A package session may be used up, or the $20 fee charged, only with the owner's yes.
matter_most.a payer: The payer sees only the date, length and bill.
matter_most.a shared phone: Only the way the client picks.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
